facts.value: Students must take at least 5 upper division elective classes (3 credits each). Students are encouraged to choose a track but they also have the option to choose any combination of courses across multiple tracks. Regardless of the chosen track, at least two of the Earth and Environmental Sciences Track Electives must be 400-level.
